_meta.purpose_one_liner: Fetch a known symbol by qualified name; verifies symbol schema: name, qualified_name, kind, file_path, line_start, line_end.
failure_modes_caught: file_path field absent (CHANGELOG 3.14.8: file attribution via containment edges, not qn.split heuristic)
kind field wrong type or absent
TS adapter returning null instead of 404-style error for unknown symbol
qualified_name overload collision: wrong symbol returned when multiple methods share name
